$description: HTCO Design 1C primitives (client ADR-0008). Semantic tokens reference these.

orange.$description: The logo's CO in the default (SBB) palette; the accent

ink.$description: The logo's HT and dot; text and the inverse fill

lilac.$description: The logo's CO in the Design 4 palette

lemon.$description: The logo's dot in the Design 4 palette; attention

sbb.$description: Design 1C, default palette (SBB: gray and orange), light theme. Demo names.

mute.$description: Decorative only: fails 4.5:1 for text (text.muted is the compliant variant)

soft.$description: Decorative only: fails 4.5:1 on the panel (text.secondary is compliant)

sbb-dark.$description: Design 1C default palette, dark theme: light ink on charcoal, the orange kept.

d4.$description: Design 1C second palette (Design 4: cream, lilac, orchid, lemon), light theme.

d4-dark.$description: Design 4 palette, dark theme: cream ink on aubergine charcoal, lilac and lemon kept.

latin.$description: Every Latin UI text and number (Design 1C)

hebrew.$description: Hebrew UI text; Outfit carries the Latin inside Hebrew text

mono.$description: IDs, tracking numbers, SKUs, code. Always rendered left-to-right.

display.$description: Titles and big numbers: the same light Outfit, set large
Titles and numbers, about -0.01em at 24 px

header.$description: The top bar and the sidebar head

flyout.$description: The area list beside the collapsed sidebar

slow.$description: Sidebar width, flyout, chevrons, panels (the demo's .28s)

glass.$description: Frosted glass (tweak 2); off by default. Web only.
